changes.label: Macau transport — practical route and alternatives

values.body:
All ranges are one-way planning estimates for two adults unless explicitly a published fare; actual meter, waiting, traffic, tolls and surcharges win. Keep HKD/MOP amounts in their original currency; use a real exchange rate if converting.
Hong Kong hotel → Sheung Wan: licensed taxi HKD180–260/car, 30–45 min; arrange 05:55 to target 06:40. Conditional MTR HKD15–25/person / HKD30–50/two, 45–60 min; not the early default without first-train verification.
Wharf → St Paul’s: taxi to the permitted Rua de D. Belchior Carneiro (高園街) taxi area near Macao Museum / nearest legal drop-off, then walk about 3–8 min to the ruins. Allow 25 min total (20–30 min estimate including pickup/drive/walk), MOP50–80/car estimated; not a taxi to the façade. DSAT lists a taxi stand here; temporary controls/signs and driver determine access. Walking the whole way needs about 35–45 min and retiming. Lisboa → Tower: taxi MOP35–60/car estimated, 25 min including pickup/wait and counter access, 12:00–12:25 target, reaching the counter before 12:30 check-in for the requested 13:00 slot. Walk MOP0, 35–45 min, cannot meet that check-in from a 12:00 departure. Tower → Asia remains MOP70–110/car, 20–30 min estimated.
Asia → Galaxy walk free MOP0, 15–25 min to the correct lobby; taxi MOP25–45/car, 10–20 min. Galaxy → Venetian walk free MOP0, 15–20 min; taxi MOP25–45/car, 10–20 min. Venetian → Parisian and Parisian → Londoner: walk free MOP0, 15–20 min each. Londoner → MGM taxi MOP25–45/car, 15 min; walk free MOP0, 20–30 min. MGM → Wynn lake walk free MOP0, 15–20 min; taxi MOP25–45/car, 10–20 min. Wynn → Asia late taxi MOP45–75/car, 15–25 min. Pai Kok/token alternatives are in the LRT note.
Optional published visitor shuttles, not an Asia Boutique service:
• Taipa Village near Rua do Cunha ↔ Parisian: Fri–Sun 11:00–19:00 every 12–15 min, MOP0; allow 25–40 min door-to-door. Confirm exact stop. It goes to Parisian, so choosing it means reorder/reduce browsing, not a Parisian→Venetian→Parisian detour. No Monday service under this pattern.
• Wynn Palace → Old Taipa Village → Lisboeta → Palace: Thu–Sun 12:00–21:00 every 30 min, MOP0. Village→Wynn goes via Lisboeta; confirm bay/direction and allow waiting/walks. No 23:15 return and no assumed 21:00 departure at every intermediate stop.
• MGM Macau ↔ Tower ↔ MGM Cotai: 09:00–23:30 every 10–15 min; Tower stops only 11:00–21:00. MOP0, budget 30–45 min including wait. Useful only for a re-anchored Tower→MGM visit, not direct to Asia and no guaranteed 16:30 show arrival. Confirm bay/direction/capacity.
• Wynn Palace → HZMB → Taipa Ferry → Airport → Palace: published loop about 30–40 min until 21:00. An airport visitor alternative only; not a direct hotel transfer or a reason to return to the former airport base.

Macau bus apps: use Google Maps first for candidate routes, bus numbers, boarding/alighting stops and walking access. Check the exact stop code, direction/destination and current diversions in DSAT’s official Bus Travelling System (巴士報站; store name may say Bus Traveling System), then watch the live vehicle position / stops remaining and any displayed arrival estimate. Macao Smart Go (澳門出行), also by DSAT, is a useful backup and offers routes plus live bus information. Tracking/ETAs can lag or fail; neither app guarantees punctuality. Recheck posted stop information and leave waiting margin. This is practical guidance for optional bus use, not a replacement for the morning taxis. Install/update from the official DSAT-linked store listing before travelling.
Official DSAT: https://www.dsat.gov.mo/dsat/index.aspx?lang=en
Smart Go (DSAT): https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=mo.gov.dsat.dis.travel

INR6,500 is a user quote for one room for two, unverified. Check all-in taxes, room type, cancellation, early checkout and late-return access before purchase. Listing says no breakfast; buy ahead for Monday 06:45 breakfast/checkout. Keep the confirmed Hong Kong room and main luggage; small overnight bag only.
Outbound: 27 Dec 07:30 TurboJET Sheung Wan → Outer Harbour, about 60 min. Taxi 05:55, reach Shun Tak around 06:40. Current published weekend daytime economy HKD212/person, HKD424/two. Return: 28 Dec 09:00 Cotai Water Jet Taipa → Sheung Wan, about 60 min; standard weekday daytime Cotai Class MOP192/person, MOP384/two. Both remain placeholders; published patterns are not December ticket inventory. Follow actual cutoffs.
UNBOOKED: requested 27 Dec 13:00 bungy for Harshith (one person), plus Skywalk for both travellers. Aim to reach Skypark’s ticketing counter by 12:25 and check in no later than 12:30, meeting the operator’s 30-minute advance-arrival rule for a 13:00 slot. Actual activity time follows registration; confirm compatible Skywalk sequencing/timing for both before purchase. Keep the Tower allowance through 16:00; early arrival is buffer, not an earlier jump or guaranteed earlier finish. Processing, queues, weather and two activities may run later.
Carry both passports, valid Hong Kong re-entry documents, actual confirmations once booked and small MOP cash. Verify data for BOTH 27 and 28 Dec, including activation/expiry. Preserve Macau Money / Transport Payments guidance. No beef or beef broth.
Morning: Wharf 09:15–09:50 → taxi plus final walk 09:50–10:15 → St Paul’s 10:15–10:35 → historic streets / brief browsing 10:35–10:45 → St Dominic’s exterior only 10:45–10:50 → walk to Senado 10:50–10:55 → Senado 10:55–11:05 → quick lunch nearby 11:05–11:35 → walk to Lisboa area 11:35–11:50 → exterior photos 11:50–12:00 → taxi including pickup/wait/counter access 12:00–12:25 → check in by 12:30 for the requested 13:00 bungy. Direct map estimates remain about 450 m / 5–6 min St Paul’s → St Dominic’s, 150 m / 2 min St Dominic’s → Senado, and 950 m / 14 min Senado → both Lisboa properties. The revised browsing/meal/photo allowances are shorter; choose quick service, cut browsing/photos first if delayed and protect the 12:00 taxi. Earlier arrival is buffer; Tower finish, hotel and evening remain as planned.
Evening: Asia → Galaxy (two lobbies) → Venetian/dinner → Parisian → Londoner → MGM Cotai → Wynn fountains → Asia. This is a long day. Protect meals, bungy and ferry buffers; shorten browsing/gaming-floor looks first, then skip Londoner show waiting and reach MGM/Wynn earlier.
